candidate_rationale.easyocr: Actively maintained PyTorch OCR; strong on irregular/display fonts; CPU path; Win/Linux/macOS; offline after model cache; no cloud API.
candidate_rationale.rapidocr: ONNX Runtime packaging of Paddle-family detectors/recognizers without full PaddlePaddle/OneDNN stack; lighter deploy story; CPU; offline after model cache.
candidate_rationale.paddleocr_skipped: Phase 3 Windows OneDNN fused_conv2d inference failure; no materially different install path attempted in this spike.
